correctness.rationale: The CRT identifies the unit-group quotient by squares with F_2^r; Legendre symbols give its generator columns. Quadratic reciprocity plus CRT makes the t sign characters independent modulo 8 times the initial odd primes. Under r log(r+2)<=C loglog X, this modulus is bounded by a fixed power of log X; Siegel--Walfisz equidistribution, union over residue classes and conditioning on distinct sampled primes give o(1) total-variation error for the entire r x (r+s) matrix. The exact binary full-row-rank product and its limiting infinite product then follow. Independently checked small exact binary rank probabilities. The limiting mean is for the limiting matrix-law variable only; it does not establish convergence of arithmetic E[J].
